title: The Peat Cutters
text: Peat cutters stand around a hole in the bog, spades lowered, not speaking. They have found a body, perfectly kept, its skin gone brown as tanned leather, a torc of gold at its throat. Its face is calm. Its throat was cut.

options.label: Buy the torc from the cutters.

outcomes.text: Old gold, older magic, warm from a throat that has been cold a thousand years.

options.label: The kindest asks them to bury it again.

outcomes.text: They grumble, and do it, and whatever the body was keeping down stays down.
A sacrifice, to keep something down, and the sacrifice is wearing off.
